files.name: dochi_cobblemon_editor-0.2.5-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.5 Change Log

  • Added compatibility with Dochi's NPC Core (in development). The mod is still under development.
  • Improved the overall UI structure and layout.
  • Fixed an issue where battle intervals were forcibly locked when battling Pokémon Itself NPCs.
  • Added Pokémon Itself capture quests (DRM integration).
  • Added Ctrl+S quick-save support in GUI screens where it was previously unavailable.
  • Added support for playing Cobblemon-specific animations in Battle Presentation.
  • Added a looping feature for Battle Sounds.
